WATERTOWN (January 10)—Watertown's riverside location and rich history have made it one of the most popular travel destinations in the region. Tourism continues to grow as visitors discover our city's increasingly wide (131)_____ of sights and attractions. As a result, Watertown's transportation office has announced that a new visitor center will be constructed on Tenth Avenue (132)_____ the growing number of tourists. (133)_____

The center's gift shop will sell many unique souvenirs. These will include candy made (134)_____ Watertown residents as well as other locally crafted products, such as apparel and artwork.

choices.A: The visitor center will be closed on Mondays.
choices.B: Some parking meters in town are out of order.
choices.C: There are several cozy coffee shops on Tenth Avenue.
choices.D: The project should be complete by the end of March.

To: Avani Mittal <amittal@mittalphotography.ca>
From: Camille Richard <crichard@brightlyboundstationery.ca>
Date: 12 August
Subject: Scheduling a photo shoot

Dear Ms. Mittal,

Brightly Bound Stationery is launching a line of notebooks, cards, and calendars in November. We want to hire a photographer who can capture the (143)_____ and minimalist look we seek. (144)_____.

We would like to hold a photo shoot sometime in September. Can you provide us with your (145)_____ for a half-day photo shoot? We prefer to start as early in the day as possible. (146)_____, please include a cost estimate for your services.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Camille Richard
Owner, Brightly Bound Stationery

choices.A: Thank you for contributing your artwork to the series.
